qs.q: Which laboratory tests are classified as nontreponemal tests used for screening and following up syphilis therapy via titer?
o: Rapid plasma reagin (RPR) and venereal disease research laboratory
Fluorescent treponemal antibody absorption testing technique
Microhemagglutination assay specific for treponemal antibodies
Immunoglobulin M serology for early diagnostic confirmation
qs.e: Rapid plasma reagin (RPR) and venereal disease research laboratory (VDRL) are nontreponemal tests used for screening and monitoring treatment response through titers. FTA-ABS and MHA-TP are specific treponemal tests that confirm these results.
